name: Camping/Wohnmobilstellplatz Hotel Krimmlerfälle
beschreibung:
Overview

The Hotel Krimmlerfälle campsite and motorhome pitch is located in Oberkrimml in the municipality of Krimml in the province of Salzburg, directly at the edge of Hohe Tauern National Park and with a view of the Krimml Waterfalls. The site is run by the Herbert Schöppl family, to whom the adjoining Hotel Krimmlerfälle also belongs. Motorhomes, campers, cars with roof tents and classic tents can all stay overnight. According to the pitch portals, around 20 pitches are available; the ground is partly gravel, partly meadow, and partly uneven as well as partly shaded. The site has a restaurant, a beer garden and a shower, and dogs are allowed. Check-in is at the hotel reception, and payment is by cash only.

Important for classification: Krimml belongs to the province of Salzburg and is not in Tirol. The assignment to a Tirol region suggested by the entry is therefore incorrect; according to promobil, the Tirol Zillertal Arena on the Gerlosplatte is merely a nearby excursion destination.

History/Background

The pitch is part of the Krimmlerfälle hotel business at Oberkrimml 42 (Wasserfallstraße 42), 5743 Krimml. The house is run by the Herbert Schöppl family, reachable by phone at +43 6564 7203. Any further documented history of the campsite's founding or construction is not recorded in the available sources, so no speculation is made about it.

Getting there

The address is Oberkrimml 42, 5743 Krimml. The site is located within the village at a restaurant; the village centre is reachable on foot according to promobil. The location is not far from the through road, which according to promobil reviews can lead to noise. The official operator's page gives the location as coordinates 47.21912 north latitude and 12.17468 east longitude. A connection to public transport is not stated in the sources.

Tips

Check-in takes place at the hotel reception, and payment can only be made in cash. The special price of 45.00 euros for a pitch with one to two people includes a hiking map, daily admission to the Krimml Waterfalls, electricity and water, as well as the local tax. In addition, adults from 15 years cost 12.00 euros, children from 0 to 14 years 6.00 euros, and pets 5.00 euros per day; the shower at the hotel costs 3.50 euros per person, the wellness area 22.00 euros per person per day. A breakfast option is also available at the hotel.

Best travel time

According to its own website, the business caters to guests on summer and winter holidays. The warm season is favoured by a visit to the Krimml Waterfalls and hikes in Hohe Tauern National Park; in autumn promobil mentions the cattle drive down from the alpine pastures; in winter, skiing is possible on the Gerlosplatte in the Zillertal Arena. A precise season specification with opening hours is not provided on the official business page.
